value.rationale: Conditioning on exactly three cycles forces rare near-spanning and fixed-size cycles to compete for total mass. The theorem identifies a nontrivial sqrt(n) balance, universal Euler-constant cutoff, and a pi-squared endpoint effect with a different logarithmic covariance decay. This is a natural dependence structure for constrained permutation profiles, not an arbitrary finite slice.
